nodes.name: Lemma 5.1: tabular c Recursion of ${\check{x}}_{n}$ tabular
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions~assump:smooth -- assump:stepsize-twotime and assump:mart-decouple-rate hold.
	Define $\tilde{\xi}_{n} := \xi_{n} - \kappa_{n} H^\star \psi_{n}$. 

	The rescaled sequences $\{ {\check{x}}_{n} \}_{n=0}^\infty$ and $\{ {\check{y}}_{n} \}_{n=0}^\infty$ defined in (11) 
	satisfy the following relationships  
	\begin{align}
		{\check{x}}_{n+1} & = ({I} - \alpha_{n} B_1) {\check{x}}_{n} - \sqrt{\alpha_{n}} \tilde{\xi}_{n} + R_{n}^x,  \\
		{\check{y}}_{n+1}
		& = \left( {I} - \beta_{n} B_3 + \frac{ \tilde{\beta} \beta_{n} }{2} {I} \right) {\check{y}}_{n} - \sqrt{\beta_{n} \alpha_{n} } B_2 {\check{x}}_{n} - \sqrt{\beta_n} \psi_{n} + R_{n}^y. 

	\end{align}
	For any $2 < p \le \frac{4}{1 + ( {\delta_H} \vee {\delta_F} \vee {\delta_G} )/2} $, 
	the residual terms $R_{n}^x$ and $R_{n}^y$ 

	have the following properties:


		(i) ${\mathbb E} \| {\mathbb E} [ R_{n}^x | {\mathcal F}_n ] \| = o(\sqrt{\beta_{n} \alpha_{n}}) $, ${\mathbb E} \| R_{n}^x \|^2 = {\mathcal O}(\beta_{n} \alpha_{n})$ and ${\mathbb E} \| R_{n}^x \|^p = o(\alpha_{n})$;

		(ii) ${\mathbb E} \| R_{n}^y \|^2 = o(\beta_{n}^2)$ and ${\mathbb E} \| R_{n}^y \|^p = o(\beta_{n})$.

nodes.name: Lemma 5.2: tabular c Recursion of ${\check{z}}_{n}$ tabular
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions~assump:smooth -- assump:stepsize-twotime and assump:mart-decouple-rate hold.
	Define 

	$\tilde{\psi}_{n} := \psi_{n} - B_2 B_1^{-1} \tilde{\xi}_n$ with $\tilde{\xi}_{n}$ defined in Lemma~5.1. The auxiliary sequences $\{ {\check{z}}_{n} \}_{n=1}^\infty$ defined in (26) satisfy the following relationships  
	\begin{equation}



		{\check{z}}_{n+1} = \left( {I} - \beta_{n} B_3 + \frac{\tilde{\beta} \beta_{n}}{2} {I} \right) {\check{z}}_{n} - \sqrt{\beta_{n}} \tilde{\psi}_{n} + R_{n}^z. 
	\end{equation}
	For any $2 < p \le \frac{4}{1 + ( {\delta_H} \vee {\delta_F} \vee {\delta_G} )/2} $, 
	the residual terms $R_{n}^z$ have the following properties:
	




		${\mathbb E} \| {\mathbb E} [ R_{n}^z | {\mathcal F}_n ] \| = o(\beta_{n} ) $, ${\mathbb E} \| R_{n}^z \|^2 = {\mathcal O}(\beta_{n}^2 )$ and ${\mathbb E} \| R_{n}^z \|^p = o(\beta_{n})$.

nodes.name: Lemma 5.3: tabular c Tightness of $\{ {\bar{\textnormal{X}}}_{n}(\cdot) \}_{n=1}^\infty$…
nodes.statement:
Suppose that Assumptions~assump:smooth -- assump:stepsize-twotime, assump:noise-fclt and assump:mart-decouple-rate hold.
	The sequences $\{ {\bar{\textnormal{X}}}_{n}(\cdot) \}_{n=1}^\infty$, $\{ {\bar{\textnormal{Y}}}_{n}(\cdot) \}_{n=1}^\infty$  
	
	and $\{ {\bar{\textnormal{Z}}}_{n}(\cdot) \}_{n=1}^\infty$ constructed in (12), (13) and (28)
	
	are tight.

nodes.name: Corollary 5.1: tabular c FCLT for $\{ {\bar{\textnormal{Z}}}_{n}(\cdot) \}_{n=1}^\infty$ tabular
nodes.statement:
Under the conditions of Theorem~4.1,
	the stochastic process ${\bar{\textnormal{Z}}}_{n}(\cdot)$ defined in (28) converges weakly to the stationary solution of the SDE in (16).
